description: This Java class defines a persistent actor for managing the state of 'Policy' objects within an Akka cluster sharding environment. It implements functions for creating actor instances, retrieving shard region references, and handling policy persistence lifecycle events, including snapshotting and event publishing.

classes.name: PolicyPersistenceActor
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractShardedPersistenceActor, responsible for managing the persistence lifecycle of Policy objects within an Akka cluster. It handles snapshotting, event publishing, and actor creation related to policies.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates the Props configuration for instantiating PolicyPersistenceActor instances with necessary parameters.

methods.name: getShardRegion
methods.description: Retrieves the Akka cluster shard region ActorRef responsible for managing Policy actors based on the provided ActorSystem.

methods.name: persistenceId
methods.description: Generates a unique persistence ID for the actor based on its entity ID.

methods.name: journalPluginId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the journal plugin used for persistence.

methods.name: snapshotPluginId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the snapshot plugin used for persistence.

methods.name: getEventClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of events this actor manages, which is PolicyEvent.

methods.name: getStrategyContext
methods.description: Provides the context for command strategies, including logging and entity ID.

methods.name: getCreatedStrategy
methods.description: Returns the strategy used for handling creation commands.

methods.name: getDeletedStrategy
methods.description: Returns the strategy used for handling deletion commands.

methods.name: getEventStrategy
methods.description: Provides the event strategy for PolicyEvent handling.

methods.name: getActivityCheckConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for activity checks from the policy configuration.

methods.name: getSnapshotConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for snapshots from the policy configuration.

methods.name: entityExistsAsDeleted
methods.description: Checks whether the current Policy entity exists and is marked as deleted.

methods.name: newNotAccessibleExceptionBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new exception builder for indicating the Policy entity is not accessible.

methods.name: publishEvent
methods.description: Publishes a PolicyEvent to the pub/sub mediator.

methods.name: getEntitySchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version implemented by the current Policy entity.
